signature: SUBROUTINE ZLAPLL( N, X, INCX, Y, INCY, SSMIN )

params.name: N
params.reference: The length of the vectors X and Y.

params.name: x
params.reference: On entry, X contains the N-vector X. On exit, X is overwritten.

params.name: incx
params.reference: The increment between successive elements of X. $\mathrm{INCX} > 0$.

params.name: y
params.reference: On entry, Y contains the N-vector Y. On exit, Y is overwritten.

params.name: incy
params.reference: The increment between successive elements of Y. $\mathrm{INCY} > 0$.

params.name: ssmin
params.reference: The smallest singular value of the N-by-2 matrix $A = ( X Y )$.
